caption: The drawing is a grayscale depiction of a metal object composed of a long, flat rectangular base with two perpendicular legs at either end, forming an elevated support. Rising from the base are two large, arching strips of metal positioned parallel to each other, with each arch flanked on either side by smaller, decorative spirals attached to the base. Extending from one end of the rectangular base is a long, narrow, flat handle that tapers slightly and ends in a small, round opening. The image is centered on a plain light background, and the artist's name, "Albert Taxson," appears in simple text in the lower left corner of the composition. The shading creates a sense of depth and texture, highlighting the contours and metallic surface of the object.
title: Toast Rack
